messages:
maria: Pushed a quick heatmap from yesterday's 40B bring-up across regions. High-level: h100/us-west looks very tight on p50 but tail stretches on long prompts. Need Dedicated sizing guidance for next-quarter commit. link: https://internal/reports/40b-heatmap

ben: Nice — thanks. Which quantization and sequence lengths? Any quality diffs we should worry about?

maria: Mostly q4f16 runs at seq=1024, a couple int8 sanity checks at seq=2048. Eval pass on our regression set is OK for q4f16; int8 shows small increase in repetition/hallucination on long contexts. Paste perf summary:

```
q4f16 / us-west / h100   : p50=45ms  p95=130ms p99=210ms  tps=75
q4f16 / eu-west / a100   : p50=60ms  p95=200ms p99=320ms  tps=50
int8  / us-west / h100   : p50=50ms  p95=160ms p99=420ms  tps=95
int8  / ap-south / a100  : p50=70ms  p95=240ms p99=510ms  tps=82
```

chun: Hmm int8 ups throughput but p99 on h100 blows up — looks like kernel fallback during certain attention shapes. Do you have runtime traces?

maria: Yep. Runtime logs show repeated `fallback_to_reference_conv` events around token 900-1200 for the long-seq int8 runs. Attaching the snippet.

ops-bot: Reminder: committing >200 GPUs for Dedicated pools triggers procurement window (72h) and SRE prep tasks.

sara: For Dedicated sizing I'd recommend targeting p99 < 250ms. Given q4f16 h100 numbers, safe concurrency per GPU is ~40 reqs (gives cushion for burst). That maps to baseline GPUs = ceil(peak_concurrency / 40). Example: if peak_concurrency=1600 -> baseline=40 GPUs.

ben: Can we lean on autoscale for short spikes? Suggest baseline +30% headroom and scale steps of 10 GPUs. Also plan a cross-region fallback to eu-west a100 if us-west h100 saturates.

maria: +30% sounds fine. I'll prepare a pool config: reserve 40 GPUs baseline in us-west h100, autoscale max +60% to allow buffer for longer events, with 10-GPU step increments. Canary rollout: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with automated p99/regression checks.

chun: Also propose we add a kernel blacklist to avoid the failing conv kernel for int8 in long-seq until ML infra fixes it. That will reduce int8 p99 spikes.

sara: Actioned items: (1) maria update pool config PR with numbers and autoscale policy, (2) chun open kernel-issue and add temporary blacklist, (3) ops to note procurement lead if final baseline >200 GPUs. I'll draft the PR description and include the heatmap and traces.

ben: Sounds good. Quick question — for billing forecast should we assume q4f16 default or a mix with int8?

maria: Default to q4f16 for baseline pricing; include a short note about int8 upside but mark it experimental until kernel fixes.

ben: :thumbsup:
